The system

ContentAwarenessTrustEngagementRegistrationNetworkingBusiness / leadsPartnershipsCommunity

How a founder story gets made

  • I interview the founder or owner.
  • A videographer captures the footage.
  • I brief the editor on the output I want.
  • The story is shown and shared at the event.

Both sides win

  • Founder: visibility, their story told well, credibility, possible business.
  • Machine Maker: proof of capability, stronger relationships, potential clients and partners, community.

How I think.

Attention is earned.

Nobody owes a brand a second. The work has to be worth stopping for.

Campaigns move people.

Looking good is the entry fee. The measure is who registered, showed up and called back.

Content is an asset.

A founder story builds trust and keeps working after the event ends.

Marketing is one chain.

Brand, content, community, sales, business. A weak link shows up at the end.

Network is net worth.

In B2B the room matters as much as the message. I build both.
